description: This file defines the IManagementGrain interface within the Orleans runtime system, detailing various administrative and diagnostic methods for managing silos and grains, including statistics collection, control commands, and grain address queries.
external_methods: Task<object[]> SendControlCommandToProvider<T>(string, int, object) where T : IControllable

classes.name: GrainCallFrequency
classes.description: Represents an estimation of the frequency of calls made from a source grain to a target grain, including source/target grains and hosts, and call count.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of silo hosts and their statuses, optionally filtering only active silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed membership information about silos, with optional filtering for active silos.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Performs activation collection on specified silos with an age limit.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Returns runtime statistics for specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Returns simple aggregated grain statistics across silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Fetches detailed grain statistics filtered by types and silos.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Gets the activation count for a specific grain reference.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Returns total grain activation count across all silos.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Runs a control command on providers matching type and name across silos.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Finds the silo address where a grain is active.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Lists all active grains of a specific type.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Estimates the call frequencies between grains across silos.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets the grain call frequency counters for specified silos.
